HOW IT WORKS

Three steps. Two seconds. No humans.

01

Payment gets stuck.

Within 2 seconds, a case opens automatically. No human notices the problem — because no human needs to.

02

The Soundbox speaks.

The customer hears it in Hindi. The merchant hears it in Tamil. Both hear the same truth at the same time.

03

Seven gates decide.

The LLM recommends. Deterministic Python decides. Every decision is logged to a hash chain that cannot be quietly edited.

THE TRUST DIAL

The merchant sets the rules. By voice.

One line — "Careful rakho" — and the whole layer changes how it acts. No forms. No settings page. No English required.
